annotations.title: Security protection missing
annotations.summary: The firewall rule that protects this server from the CVE-2026-98432 Linux kernel bug is not in place.
annotations.impact: Until it is back, a specially crafted network packet could crash or take over this server.
annotations.action: Re-apply the protection now: run the observer/host hardening script again, then check with: nft list table ip cve_2026_98432.
